description: Return every fact one filing tagged that maps to a FinancialMD concept, across all statements in one call: income statement, balance sheet, cash flow and supplemental (share counts, per-share figures), each in display order with the newest period first. Each fact is a value object with the filer's XBRL taxonomy, tag and dimensions, the concept it maps to, its label, and a proof pointing at the page and anchor in the filing. Prior-year comparatives printed in the filing are included (their fiscal labels are null). Tags without a mapping (company extensions) are not included. Use it to read a filing end to end instead of calling financials_as_reported once per statement.

accession.description: SEC accession number in dashed form, for example 0000320193-24-000123.

limit.description: Maximum number of periods or items to return (default 2000, at most 5000).

statement.description: Optional: only facts of this statement.

name: filing_facts

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { filing (summary, company, fact_count), statements: [{ statement, facts: [value object + taxonomy, tag, dims, is_instant, label, concept_id, display_order, is_subtotal] }], returned, truncated }.

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: Facts of one filing
